claims.statement: The server's entire persistence surface is eight public tables declared in apps/server/src/db/schema.ts (admin_users, fare_configs, routes, directions, stops, detours, detour_stops, restrictions), reached only through a pg Pool + drizzle instance built from DATABASE_URL and injected as Db into buildApp.

The foreign-key topology cascades downward: routes→directions→{stops,detours,restrictions} and detours→detour_stops are ON DELETE CASCADE, routes.fare_config_id is ON DELETE SET NULL, and migration 0002 adds admin_users.user_id → auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE.

DELETE has three different meanings: routes and detours are physically removed (cascading to their children), directions/stops/restrictions are soft-deleted by setting is_active = false, and fare_configs can only be soft-deactivated behind active-route-reference and last-default guards.

directions.origin_stop_id and destination_stop_id are unconstrained text columns with their own btree indexes rather than foreign keys, so terminal referential integrity is enforced in application code by assertNotDirectionTerminal (409 on stop delete) and re-verified by referenceCheck() in the export assembler.

stops has only a non-unique btree on (direction_id, stop_order), so the base chain's gap-free ordering is a write-path invariant (normalizeStopOrder plus index+1 on the plotting save, max+1 on append), whereas detour_stops enforces a unique (detour_id, stop_order) and numbers rows 0-based from array position.

Geometry is declared as two custom Drizzle types (geometry(Point,4326) and geometry(LineString,4326)) whose declared data type is string; every read and write goes through SQL expressions in db/queries.ts (ST_AsGeoJSON(col)::jsonb on read, ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(...)::geometry(...) on write) and call sites cast the SQL expression 'as unknown as string'.

The meter helpers pointOnLineMeters (ST_DWithin on ::geography) and pointDistanceToLineMeters (ST_Distance on ::geography) are exported from db/queries.ts but called by no handler; detour on-line and loop-endpoint validation is instead computed in domain/validation.ts with a local haversine.
stops.location is the only spatially indexed column (GiST index stops_location_gist); the other geometry columns are read by primary key or by parent id.

fare_configs numeric columns are read and written as Drizzle string mode: the handler writes String(value), reads/exports convert back with Number() (serialize()/num()), and the zod schemas require numbers on the wire — a deliberate consequence of drizzle-orm 0.36.x having no numeric mode, not a defect.

The direction_kind enum is declared ('base','return') in that order and Postgres compares enums by declaration order, so the route detail and /routes/overview queries order with direction_kind ASC (plus created_at and direction_id tiebreakers) to guarantee the admin-plotted base direction is returned before its derived return.
Primary keys are text values generated in the server — prefixed UUIDs via uuidId, or slugs via uniqueSlug with 'overview' reserved — with no database-side sequence, identity or UUID default.

The 'exactly one default fare configuration' rule is enforced only in application code: there is no partial unique index on fare_configs.is_default, and promoting a new default runs an un-mark statement followed by a mark statement outside a transaction.

created_at/updated_at default to now() with no ON UPDATE trigger and no Drizzle $onUpdate, and no server code path ever writes updated_at, so it stays at insert time even though GET /api/admin/routes orders by updated_at DESC and /api/status reports dataset_updated_at as max(directions.updated_at).

Soft-deleted rows remain visible to reads: loadStops/loadDetours/loadRestrictions and readExportRows apply no is_active filter, the export payload carries is_active only for routes and directions, and /api/status counts every row on every table regardless of is_active.

Admin authorization is membership in admin_users: isAdminUserId (a row exists for the authenticated Supabase user id) is the single gate consulted by the admin guard and login paths, and the grant is revoked by deleting the row — the FK from auth.users means deleting the auth user cascades the grant away, with no disabled or audit column.

Migrations reach a database by two paths: supabase start / supabase db reset, where config.toml enables [db.migrations] and runs the idempotent ./seed.sql afterwards (admin auth user, admin_users grant, 'default' fare config), and the integration harness, which recreates komyuter_test, stubs the auth schema, replays every migration .sql in filename order, and drops the database on teardown.

migrations/meta/_journal.json records only 0001_hard_roland_deschain while files 0002-0005 exist on disk and are referenced by the Drizzle schema and handlers; as recorded in docs/DEVIATIONS.md Appendix A1, a plain supabase db reset therefore applies only 0000+0001, leaving the applied database behind the code (missing admin_users → auth.users FK and directions.direction_kind).

No migration contains a GRANT or row-level-security policy, so the trusted DATABASE_URL connection plus the admin_users guard are the entire authorization boundary, and any non-ApiError database failure surfaces as the generic 500 INTERNAL envelope rather than as a constraint-specific status.

drizzle-kit is configured to generate migration SQL from apps/server/src/db/schema.ts into supabase/migrations, but no root, turbo or package script runs it — generation is a manual invocation, and migrations 0000, 0002, 0003, 0004 and 0005 are hand-written additions.

The plotting save persists the base direction, its ordered stops, its terminal pointers, the derived return and the return's own stop rows inside a single db.transaction, so a rejected payload (fewer than two stops, path not ending on first/last stop, third active direction) leaves no partial rows.

An empty Drizzle patch is guarded rather than executed: the detour PUT skips the UPDATE when the patch object has no keys, because update().set({}) is invalid SQL and would surface as a 500 on a detour_stops-only edit.
